main.lab_name: lab-directory, insight:rare — every lab named (businesses and public labs)
main.address: lab-directory, chart-city, kpi:cities, insight:city — city = text after the last comma; a cell listing several sites is shown as כמה אתרים
main.phone: lab-directory — the lab's business numbers as listed by the ministry, whitespace cleaned
main.email: chart-combo, kpi:gov, insight:gov — domain only (gov.il marks a government lab); addresses never shown, several are named individuals' mailboxes
main.test_material: text:lede — constant (מזון) today; a second material is listed in the lede with counts
main.test_type: chart-combo, lab-directory, kpi:multi, insight:both, insight:types, insight:rare — comma-separated list split into types; unknown types flow through
main.district: skip: filled in only 1 of 12 rows (>80% empty)
main.fax: skip: fax numbers add nothing a visitor needs beyond the phone; available in the explorer
